name: A Night With: Spirit
source:
Trapped within an old television, a ghostly girl with a mysterious past, awaits a player who can help her break free.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个有着神秘过去的幽灵女孩被困在一台旧电视机里，等待着能够帮助她挣脱束缚的玩家。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146280/]Steam[/url]]
